records.explanation: The warehouse has no credit score field for customers; the tables only hold invoices, payments, deals and receivables amounts.
The deal tables (staging.stg_deals, marts.deal_to_cash) have no salesperson or owner column, so deals can't be attributed to a salesperson.
The warehouse has no cost of goods sold or product cost data (only invoices, orders, deals, payments), so gross margin can't be calculated.
The warehouse covers deals, orders, invoices, payments and receivables only, with no support ticket data, so tickets opened by Acme Corporation can't be counted.

The warehouse only holds posted invoices, orders, deals and payments up to 2026-10-27. It has no billing schedule, subscription or forecast data, so next month's billing can't be derived without guessing.
